items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: They hired me from the country to play with a, Sonny Henry recommended me to a band, they call it the Terramir band... So they had the same Sonny Henry playing the trombone... I only left two tramboyant plays when I was Sonny Henry

ctx.x: Just had a white coat and white cap. You could get a cap for 25 cents at that time, for that last year's day. Things was cheap. And my drum player, the bass drum player had to get a pair of tennis shoes like, you know? Black one, like that. His feet was hiding him and he had tennis shoes to make that parade. And then we went on that parade and all them bands, big bands, well we didn't think, we thought our band was the least on that, you know? And we went to playin' that day and they used to make some long…
